title: Small-prime component obstruction
assumptions: rho reduced mod a small prime; the 14 AC moves act on the finite pair graph
connected components of that graph are preserved by every move
idea adapted from jackyreaps/X-files: a parity that cannot flip is a global selection rule
output_meaning: Whether the image pair lies in the connected component of (X,Y) mod each prime. Outside means no AC path exists at all.
limits: Unconditional but vacuous on this pool: 9 of 36 pairs are outside mod 2 and 64 of 576 mod 3, yet zero of the 10,115 competition rows land outside either.
